scenery @1:look#0.name: little mailbox
scenery @1:look#0.text:
Post Office
This is the lobby of the Festeron Post Office. The walls are lined with small, private mailboxes and wanted posters. A service counter runs along the entire length of the room.
 
Your boss, Mr. Crisp, is watching you impatiently.
 
Mr. Crisp reaches under the service counter and pulls out a mysterious envelope. "We just got this Special Delivery," he snarls, tossing it onto the service counter. "I want you to drop it off right away. That means NOW!"
 
What next?
>

scenery @1:examine little mailbox#1.name: little mailbox
scenery @1:examine little mailbox#1.text:
The little mailboxes are closed and locked.
 
Mr. Crisp drums his fingers on the service counter impatiently. "Scram, idiot! The Magick Shoppe closes at five o'clock!"
 
What next?
>

scenery @11:look#6.name: gravedigger
scenery @11:look#6.text:
Spooky Copse
A copse of willow trees makes this part of the cemetery look really spooky. Narrow lanes wander south and west.
 
There's an open grave nearby, freshly dug, with a tombstone erected next to it.
 
An old gravedigger is resting under a willow tree.
 
The gravedigger notices the mysterious envelope you're holding. "That's a mighty mysterious-lookin' envelope you got there," he says. "Let's have a look at it."
 
>

scenery @11:examine gravedigger#7.name: gravedigger
scenery @11:examine gravedigger#7.text:
He's the town gravedigger, a village fixture since before you were born.
 
"Sure would like to get a closer look at that mysterious envelope."
 
>

scenery @11:look#8.name: open grave
scenery @11:look#8.text:
Spooky Copse
A copse of willow trees makes this part of the cemetery look really spooky. Narrow lanes wander south and west.
 
There's an open grave nearby, freshly dug, with a tombstone erected next to it.
 
An old gravedigger is resting under a willow tree.
 
"Got to go," says the gravedigger, picking up his shovel. "See you soon."
 
The old man ambles away to the west.
 
>

scenery @11:examine open grave#9.name: open grave
scenery @11:examine open grave#9.text:

scenery @12:look#16.name: umbrella
scenery @12:look#16.text:
Twilight Glen
The trees here are so thick, it's almost too dark to see! You can make out a closed iron gate to the north, and a narrow lane between the tombstones winds off to the east.
 
There must have been a burial here recently. Somebody left their umbrella leaning up against a tombstone.
 
>

scenery @12:examine umbrella#17.name: umbrella
scenery @12:examine umbrella#17.text:
The handle of the closed umbrella is carved like a parrot's head.
 
>

>

scenery @20:look#20.name: Alexis
scenery @20:look#20.text:
Outside Cottage
You're outside the cottage of Miss Voss, the town librarian. The road turns north toward the village, and bends upward to the summit of Post Office Hill.
 
An angry poodle is blocking your path.
 
The poodle glares at you through eyes red with hatred.
 
>

scenery @20:examine alexis#21.name: Alexis
scenery @20:examine alexis#21.text:
The poodle decides that you're only guessing its name, and yaps all the louder.
 
You can hear the poodle's sharp little teeth snapping as it nips your heels.
 
>

scenery @20:look#22.name: poodle
scenery @20:look#22.text:
Outside Cottage
You're outside the cottage of Miss Voss, the town librarian. The road turns north toward the village, and bends upward to the summit of Post Office Hill.
 
An angry poodle is blocking your path.
 
The poodle circles you warily, snarling and growling with menace.
 
>

scenery @20:examine poodle#23.name: poodle
scenery @20:examine poodle#23.text:
The poodle is tiny, mean and hungry-looking.
 
You can smell the poodle's hot breath as it yaps.
 
>

scenery @23:look#24.name: violet note
scenery @23:look#24.text:
Rotary South
This is the south side of the Festeron Rotary. A road branches south, towards Post Office Hill.
 
The Festeron Public Library, famous for its museum of local historic artifacts, stands proudly on the nearby corner.
 
"Here's the note," says Miss Voss, holding it out to you.
 
>

scenery @23:examine violet note#25.name: violet note
scenery @23:examine violet note#25.text:
It's a folded sheet of pale violet paper, sealed with a dab of library paste. The name "Corky" is beautifully handwritten on the outside.
 
"Take this note," says Miss Voss, holding it out to you.
 
>

scenery @27:look#26.name: gold coin
scenery @27:look#26.text:
Park
You're standing in a circular park, surrounded by the Festeron Rotary. Walks converge from four directions on a shallow marble fountain, filled with sparkling water.
 
A statue stands in the middle of the fountain.
 
>

scenery @27:examine gold coin#27.name: gold coin
scenery @27:examine gold coin#27.text:
The gold coin is etched with a profile of one of Festeron's founding fathers.
 
>
